description.text: Root files for the first create, including LICENSE from the project license, a slim .gitignore, and ChoosingPackageBoundaries.md. src/global.json is optional and unchecked by default. version.json is not a checkbox here; choose This repository on a first create to add the root file. Visual Studio requires at least one value; choose None when adding another console app to the same repository.

Where this app's .slnx is written. Default src/sln/{name}/ with the handbook beside that file. Other locations: repository root (src/sln/{name}/ stays as notes), or src/prj/{name}/ next to the console app csproj (slnx and handbook; no src/sln/{name}/). Several .slnx files in the same folder make `dotnet` require an explicit path (MSB1011). Visual Studio also creates a root .slnx; close Visual Studio, open the template solution, and delete the extra root .slnx.
Checked values write explicit C# and debug properties on the console app, tests, and benchmark. XML documentation is console-app-only and off by default. Uncheck one to write the alternative.

Default is This app (Properties/version.json) on every create. This repository writes root version.json on a first create; later apps keep This repository and choose None for root items. Off keeps VersionPrefix in the console app project.
Adds Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.PublicApiAnalyzers to this console app. The first build writes Properties/PublicAPI baseline files if they are missing. Test and benchmark projects are not affected.

Optional DocShell.html seed. NuGet package docs go under this app's Properties/NugetAssets/docs and pack with the nupkg. Repository docs go under docs/ at the repo root (first create only). Choose None when adding another console app unless you only want package docs. Bootstrap and mini docs are a checkpoint task.
Default MIT. Standard licenses set PackageLicenseExpression and keep License.txt on disk. Custom packs License.txt as the NuGet license file. The LICENSE file at repository root copies this license.

name.text: Code style rules for console app project

description.text: Single choice. Default is Strict: naming, XML docs, nullable, and unused usings fail the build. Default (style suggestions) is the same dump without those errors. Off writes no file. Test and benchmark projects are not affected.
SDK CA rules on the console app only. Default Recommended. Minimum is fewer warnings. All is almost every CA rule. Separate from code style Strict and from Public API analyzers.

name.text: Treat high/critical NuGet vulnerabilities as errors

description.text: Default on. Restore fails this console app on high (NU1903) and critical (NU1904) vulnerable packages. Low and moderate stay warnings. Uncheck for an EOL or backport graph. Test and benchmark projects are not affected. NugetReport next to the tests lists that app and is still info-only.

Single choice. Default is Coverlet: dotnet test fails below 100% line, branch, and method coverage on the console app. Edit Threshold in the test csproj if you want less. Coverlet and ReportGenerator also writes HTML/Markdown. None writes no extra test packages. ReportGenerator needs Coverlet output, so the two are not independent checkboxes.

Default off. Writes empty Directory.Build.props and Directory.Build.targets beside this console app, and Directory.Solution.props and Directory.Solution.targets beside this app's .slnx. Landing files for extra MSBuild. Tests and benchmark are not affected. No Directory.Packages.props.

Default on. Writes an empty .config/dotnet-tools.json beside this console app (no tools). Landing file for dotnet tool install --local. Uncheck to skip. Tests and benchmark are not affected. Does not restore tools on build.
